description: Candidate lay-language mappings considered and rejected by Peter's Kiro, with reasons. Rejected entries must never be used by an extractor. Codes: NOT_EQUIVALENT (sounds related but means something else), AMBIGUOUS (several HPO terms fit), TOO_SPECIFIC (the phrase cannot support the detail in the term), TOO_GENERAL (the phrase cannot support any single term).

entries.reason: Foamy urine can suggest proteinuria, but it is a symptom with other causes; proteinuria is a test result. Keep them apart.
'Scarred liver' could mean hepatic fibrosis (HP:0001395) or cirrhosis (HP:0001394). The case gold uses Cirrhosis because the article says cirrhosis, but the phrase alone does not decide.

entries.phrase: kidney blood test was higher than normal
entries.reason: A raised kidney blood test could be creatinine, urea or cystatin C.

entries.phrase: does not interact with us the way other children do
entries.reason: Autism is a diagnosis made by formal assessment; a parent's description of social difficulty is closer to Reduced social responsiveness (HP:0012760) or Abnormal social behavior (HP:0012433), and even those need context.
A macule is defined by size; the lay phrase does not give size. Mapped to Hypopigmented skin patches (HP:0001053) instead.
'Small' feet is not the same as 'short' feet. The case gold uses Short foot with a caveat; the dictionary does not.
General learning difficulty could be intellectual disability or a specific learning disability; the phrase does not say which.
Could be hesitancy (HP:0000019), retention (HP:0000016) or painful urination.
'Constructive cognition' is a narrow neuropsychological construct; the lay phrase fits several visuospatial or visual-perception terms.

Spasticity is an examination finding; a lay reader cannot tell spastic stiffness from rigidity. Lower limb spasticity (HP:0002061) plus Lower limb muscle weakness (HP:0007340) would still be an inference.

entries.phrase: tiny crystals in the clear front part of his eyes
entries.reason: The crystal type is a laboratory or clinical judgement; mapped to Corneal crystals (HP:0000531) instead.
Cannot distinguish heparan, dermatan or keratan sulfate, or other glycans.
'Unusual face' does not specify shape, features or proportions.

entries.phrase: narrowing just above a heart valve
entries.reason: The phrase does not say which valve; supravalvular pulmonary stenosis (HP:0034349) also fits.
The lay phrase cannot locate the deposits within the kidney; mapped to Nephrocalcinosis (HP:0000121) instead.
